_comment: Pack catalogue seed. PostgreSQL is authoritative after installation; personal pack_settings.json cannot override it. specialRarityWeights is retained as legacy metadata and does not control player-pack draws.
_storePacksComment: The store lives in PostgreSQL (store_packs, edited live in the panel) since migration 041, and migrations 095-097 replaced the bundled store, so storePacks and alwaysPresentPackIds stay empty here; the server replaces these file rules with the database's at start-up. Since pack odds v3 (migration 117, docs/pack-odds-v3.md) there is one kind of pack: the former reward-only packs are ordinary packs outside the store lineup, and every pack draws from its own complete category_chances table. Player-pack draws select saved promo buckets; legacy special_weights values are ignored. Packs listed in alwaysPresentPackIds are restored when a saved configuration lacks them. Pack keys: min_rating/max_rating, allowed_rareflags, allowed_team_ids and allowed_nations limit the players; chem_style_chance puts a chemistry style in the lowest common slot; points_price overrides the FIFA Points price. allowed_currencies limits the store currencies (coins, points); admin_only (Grant only) packs are never listed or sold; promo_only requires every player slot to be special; category_chances is the rare-slot odds table: one chance per special category (and "upgraded" for specials whose base card is in the slot's lower tier), the rest drawing a standard rare; forced specials use its rows rescaled; player_picks lists pick tokens [{count, min_rating, choice_count, promo_only, rareflags, label}], followed by bonus_player_count unique players rated bonus_min_rating or more (bonus_promo_only: specials only); random_consumable_count and random_manager_count draw distinct position modifiers and chemistry styles, or managers; identity_pack draws balls, badges, kits and stadium cards the club does not own yet ({balls, badges, kits, stadiums}).
_packSizeComment: The largest player pack the server builds (retail tops out at 30 items); the all-kits pack keeps its own limit.
_customPackComment: Starting values for a pack defined only partially in store_packs.json or pack_settings.json. {id} is replaced by the pack id.

customPack.name: Custom Pack {id}
customPack.bio: A custom FIFA 21 Ultimate Team pack.

_packFiveComment: Pack 5 names from older builds that are replaced by the current built-in pack 5.
_displayOnlyComment: Reward names shown by the client that are not openable packs.
_playerPickComment: The reward pack delivering an N+ player pick, by minimum rating. The lowest rating is the default.
_storeGroupsComment: Store tabs a pack can be listed under (store_group), with their category id. Aliases map legacy Pack Studio names; any other value falls back to the pack's dominant tier.
_artComment: A pack without a store category draws pack art by band (1 bronze, 2 silver, 3 gold, 4 special) chosen by pack id range.
_storeArtComment: A pack draws the art of its store category (store_group) whenever it names one. Without one, ids below 100 draw the art of their dominant tier and higher ids the id band.
_tiersComment: Card tier when the catalog does not name one, and the rating from which a base card counts as rare in its tier.
_eliteComment: Pack selection weight boost for high ratings: 1 below fromRating, then +perRating per point, capped. Off since migration 068 (phase-1 odds): packs draw by saved rating bucket instead.
